posts.title: systemd journal forwarding
posts.description: I’ve been working on software to make it faster to do local system reimaging. In order to make it easier to troubleshoot problems, I wanted to have local logs forwarded to another system. As I am currently relying on cloud-init images, most of the system logs are already going to systemd’s journal, but how can I forward the journal to a remote system? Systemd already provides a tool, systemd-journ

posts.title: Debian 13 boot loop on qemu
posts.description: Everything was going nicely until Debian 13 was stuck in a boot loop. Qemu repeated the following, endlessly blinking in my terminal: Booting `Debian GNU/Linux' Loading Linux 6.12.85+deb13-amd64 ... Why? I’m developing a tool to help me build desktop VM images to help me debug weird issues specific to certain Linux distributions. For this project, I’m starting with each linux distro’s cloud image
